lines.text: Stop. They have not decided about you.
Easy. Easy. ...Tavik Roon. The herd is mine to walk. Not mine.
Walk. They are nobody's. They just go where I go because I go slow.

choice.text: How do I know when they have decided?
We are in a hurry. Can you move them?

lines.text: ...The sentinel drops its head. That is yes. Wait for it.
No. Hurry is how Dust Grazers die. Do not do it.
